weather_report:
Good morning, Islamabad. As we begin this Thursday, November 13th, the capital is waking up to a crisp and remarkably clear sky, signaling a day of comfortable warmth without the usual autumnal chill. Temperatures are currently hovering around 24.8 degrees Celsius, providing a pleasant thermal environment that feels significantly milder than the recent trends. With relative humidity sitting at a low 24.5 percent, the air remains dry and light, ensuring that the perceived temperature aligns closely with the actual reading, offering a refreshing start to your morning commute.

Turning to our environmental metrics, the air quality index stands at a healthy 30.9, which places us firmly in the "Good" category. This indicates that air pollution levels are at a minimum, and there is little to no risk for sensitive groups. With particulate matter levels remaining well within safe limits, you can breathe easy as you head out into the fresh air. The low humidity further aids in the dispersion of any minor pollutants, keeping the atmosphere clean and clear for all residents, particularly those with respiratory sensitivities who can enjoy the day without concern.

Looking ahead to the rest of the day, there are no active weather warnings in effect, and the risk of precipitation is negligible at just 22 percent, with expected rainfall limited to a mere 0.05 millimeters. The UV index is currently low at 0.17, though it will likely rise as the sun climbs higher, so standard sun protection is still advised for prolonged outdoor exposure. Winds are calm at 1.4 kilometers per hour from the southeast, creating stable conditions ideal for outdoor activities, travel, and daily planning. We encourage you to take advantage of this serene weather window for any outdoor errands or leisure activities, as the forecast points to a smooth and uneventful day ahead.
